label: Reject Artifacts without exactly one producing Piece
summary: fail before supersession storage when Artifact provenance is missing or ambiguous

execute.description: fail before supersession storage when Artifact provenance is missing or ambiguous
execute.sql:
INSERT INTO "artifact" ("id", "authorAgentId", "title", "uri", "createdAt")
SELECT a."id", a."authorAgentId", a."title", a."uri", a."createdAt"
FROM "artifact" a LEFT JOIN "pieceArtifact" pa ON pa."artifactId" = a."id"
GROUP BY a."id" HAVING COUNT(pa."artifactId") <> 1
